BOBA Sample GTM Document — For Testing Purposes

Section 1: Executive Summary
This document provides a sample GTM strategy for testing the BOBA document
ingestion pipeline. It contains enough text to produce multiple chunks when
processed by the chunking algorithm.

Section 2: Market Analysis
The B2B SaaS market for GTM tooling is growing rapidly. Organizations spend
significant time manually compiling intelligence from disparate documents stored
in Google Drive and other collaboration tools.

Section 3: Target Segments
Primary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (50-500 employees, $5M-$50M ARR)
Secondary: Enterprise technology companies with complex GTM motions
Tertiary: High-growth startups preparing for scale

Section 4: Competitive Landscape
Key competitors operate in adjacent categories but lack integrated AI intelligence:
- Traditional CRM platforms: strong data capture but no synthesis
- BI tools: dashboards without narrative intelligence
- Document search tools: retrieval without insight generation

Section 5: Go-To-Market Strategy
Our go-to-market approach targets marketing and revenue operations leaders who
feel the pain of information fragmentation most acutely. We lead with the Drive
Knowledge Hub as an immediate pain-solver, then expand to AI insights.

Section 6: Success Metrics
Time-to-insight: < 2 minutes from query to actionable recommendation
Drive sync coverage: >= 95% of mapped files indexed within 24 hours
Source citation accuracy: >= 90% verified citations across AI-generated insights
User adoption: >= 60% weekly active users of licensed seats within 90 days
